# markups

Sheet review markups: list marked sheets, render full sheets or tight markup crops with vivid redlines over monochrome linework, add strokes, and yellow-line (mark addressed), resolve or clear review markups.

Every example below is a complete script that passes the kit's checks; the kit's tests run each one.

- [`markups.sheetsWithMarkups`](#markupssheetswithmarkups): Lists every sheet in the drawing set that carries review markups matching status (default "open"), with counts, paper bounds, and overlapped viewports.
- [`markups.list`](#markupslist): Lists review markups on one sheet (by id or sheet number), including paper bounds and exact model coordinates (ft) for every viewport each stroke sits over.
- [`markups.renderSheet`](#markupsrendersheet): Queues a sheet PNG image with human review markups drawn in vivid colour over crisp monochrome linework, optionally auto-cropped around specific markup ids or open markups.
- [`markups.renderAllMarkedSheets`](#markupsrenderallmarkedsheets): Finds every sheet with open review markups and queues full-sheet + zoomed-crop PNG images in one call (up to 6 images), returning the sheet summary.
- [`markups.add`](#markupsadd): Adds a felt-tip marker or highlighter review markup stroke onto a sheet in paper coordinates (mm or units.*).
- [`markups.markAddressed`](#markupsmarkaddressed): Yellow-lines one or more sheet review markups as addressed (backcheck style) with an optional note of what was revised.
- [`markups.resolve`](#markupsresolve): Marks one or more sheet review markups as resolved (hidden from active review views).
- [`markups.reopen`](#markupsreopen): Reopens addressed or resolved sheet review markups back to open redline status.
- [`markups.clear`](#markupsclear): Deletes sheet review markups on a sheet (optionally only those matching status).

## markups.sheetsWithMarkups

Lists every sheet in the drawing set that carries review markups matching status (default "open"), with counts, paper bounds, and overlapped viewports.

```ts
sheetsWithMarkups(ctx: ScriptContext, opts?: { status?: MarkupStatus | "all" }): readonly MarkedSheetSummary[]
```

Topics: markups, redlines, sheets with markups, review, marker

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const sh = documents.sheet(ctx, { number: "M-101", name: "Mechanical Plan" });
    markups.add(ctx, sh, { points: [{ x: 120, y: 120 }, { x: 260, y: 120 }], color: "#dc2626" });
    ctx.report("Marked sheets", markups.sheetsWithMarkups(ctx));
  },
});
```

</details>

## markups.renderSheet


## markups.renderAllMarkedSheets

Finds every sheet with open review markups and queues full-sheet + zoomed-crop PNG images in one call (up to 6 images), returning the sheet summary.

```ts
renderAllMarkedSheets(ctx: ScriptContext, opts?: RenderAllMarkedSheetsOptions): { readonly sheets: readonly MarkedSheetSummary[]; readonly queuedRenders: readonly ScriptRenderRequest[] }
```

Topics: markups, redlines, all marked sheets, grab markups, render images, revision

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const sh = documents.sheet(ctx, { number: "M-101", name: "Mechanical Plan" });
    markups.add(ctx, sh, { points: [{ x: 140, y: 150 }, { x: 280, y: 150 }] });
    const res = markups.renderAllMarkedSheets(ctx);
    ctx.report("Marked sheets", res.sheets);
  },
});
```
